title: A power saving for square-difference-free sets
summary: We prove that there are absolute constants c > 0 and C < ∞ such that every set $`A\subseteq\{1,\ldots,N\}`$ with no nonzero square difference satisfies $`|A|\le C N^{1-c}`$. This answers the fixed-power question posed by Green and Sawhney.
family_title: Power savings for intersective polynomial differences and prime arguments

review.reason: Proves a power-saving size bound for sets with no nonzero square differences.
